name: Vengeance on the Northspring
summary: Talo Thornhoof seeks vengeance on the Northspring harpies to the west. Once a hunter who feared no creature, Talo has hated them since they ambushed Talo in the forest.

sections.title: An Old Hunter's Grudge
sections.body: Talo Thornhoof once hunted the wild without fear. After a hard fight, Talo stayed in the forest to hone a weapon. Then harpies closed in, and Talo barely escaped to safety. Their cries still echo in Talo's memory. Talo's life was never the same, and the hatred has endured. Now Talo wants revenge.

sections.title: The Northspring Harpies
sections.body: The Northspring harpies live to the west. Talo asks you to kill four Northspring Harpies, four Northspring Roguefeathers, four Northspring Windcallers and four Northspring Slayers. Their wings are black as night, Talo warns. They can vanish into the darkness.

sections.title: After the Hunt
sections.body: Talo Thornhoof, an old tauren, thanks you for the hunt. Your work has brought peace to a troubled mind.

aliases: who gives vengeance on the northspring
faq.answer: Talo Thornhoof once hunted the wild without fear. Harpies ambushed Talo in the forest, and Talo was never the same afterward.

faq.q: Where are the Northspring harpies located?
faq.answer: The Northspring harpies live to the west of Talo Thornhoof.

faq.q: Why does Talo want revenge against the harpies?
faq.answer: After a hard fight, Talo Thornhoof stayed in the forest to hone a weapon. Harpies surrounded Talo, who barely escaped. Talo was never the same and has carried hatred ever since.

faq.q: Which harpies does Talo want killed?
faq.answer: Talo wants four each of the Northspring Harpies, Northspring Roguefeathers, Northspring Windcallers and Northspring Slayers killed.

faq.q: What do the Northspring harpies look like?
faq.answer: Talo says the Northspring harpies have wings black as night and can vanish into the darkness.
